_comment: lite_pro sets only the integrator. implicitfast integrates the actuator damping, as the MuJoCo docs recommend. The other <option> attributes keep the MuJoCo defaults. exclude: at rest, the pelvis capsule across the hip motors overlaps both butt (hip_roll) capsules, and over most of the waist_pitch range the chest sphere overlaps the pelvis capsule (3.0 cm at -1.57 rad, 1.2 cm at 0.79 rad).
